sentences.text: Remains were discovered within the Dukamaje Formation in Nigeria.
Some cranial material of Sokotosuchus has possibly been found in collections from Mali.
Halstead named the genus in 1975, establishing Sokotosuchus ianwilsoni as the defining species.
Its parent group is identified as Phosphatosaurinae.
The creature inhabited the region between 72.2 and 56 million years ago, spanning the Maastrichtian into the Thanetian.
It lived during the Maastrichtian stage in western Africa.
